scope: All six AE0 grid-selection branches, full/limited luma, signed BLS/gain correction, preserved fields and weighted mean
limitations: Standard roundf is modeled as IEEE single-precision round-to-nearest with ties away from zero; other processing executes original ARM instructions.
Finite inputs with positive weight sum; zero-weight mean is rejected by Rust rather than reproducing the original division/conversion path.
This is a 5x5 measurement helper, not the exposure-control algorithm or full statistics translator.
